text:
elaine: Heads-up team — we're rolling out a quickstart runbook + sample code rules. Core points: quickstarts must run out-of-the-box (container or single-command), include SPDX license header, and opt-in sample telemetry only. See PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/499 for full policy.

sam: Is this mandatory for every SDK at once?

elaine: Staged rollout — JS + Python first (deadline Apr 15). Other SDKs follow in 6-8 weeks. The PR has the schedule matrix.

ben: Will there be starter Dockerfiles / a smoke-test harness we can copy?

maria: Yes. Added canonical templates under docs/examples/docker-templates and a small smoke-test harness: scripts/quickstart_smoke.sh. CI will use RW_EXAMPLE_MODE=1 to run.

ben: Perfect. I'll adapt the python quickstart to use the template.

oakley: CI impact for repos owning examples? We need to gate docs merges on passing smoke-tests.

docs-ci-bot: New CI pipeline: docs/quickstart-smoke-tests (build -> run -> verify). Failures mark the docs PR as blocked.

sam: Clarify telemetry: examples must not phone-home by default, right?

elaine: Exactly. No telemetry unless user explicitly opts in. Add this canonical snippet in examples and README:

```
# opt-in telemetry (examples): users must opt in to enable sample telemetry
export RW_EXAMPLE_TELEMETRY=1
```

maria: Also requirement: add an SPDX header to top of all example files and a short license blurb in the quickstart README. Legal templates are in docs/legal/examples-license.md.

ben: What about the old one-line snippets in guides? Any deprecation plan?

elaine: Yes — snippet-only quickstarts will be deprecated. They'll be supported for 30 days after Apr 15, then moved to docs/legacy-examples. Owners will get an automated notification 7 days before archive.

maria: We're adding metadata to examples so owners can opt into a local/private variant (runtime=private) that includes KMS and env guidance for Dedicated/Private setups.

sam: Who approves these changes?

elaine: Approval chain: Docs PM (me), SDK leads (ben for python/js), and Security (oakley). Legal reviews for license text (legal-bot will add comments).

legal-bot: License templates attached. Please ensure SPDX headers match the chosen example license.

maria: Owner action list: 1) convert snippet-only quickstarts to container or single-script; 2) add SPDX header; 3) include opt-in telemetry snippet + README note; 4) add smoke-test entry in examples manifest. Phase 1 due Apr 15 for JS/Python.

ben: I'll own python.

sam: I'll take JS.

elaine: Thanks. If you hit blockers ping me or reply here. I'll run a 30-min workshop next Wed 10am to walk through the template and CI.
